title: [v0.92.1][PROV-B] Local-model shadow execution
body:
## Outcome

Produce one bounded local-model shadow-execution path that cannot acquire authority.

## Primary deliverable

One bounded local-model shadow-execution and comparison path that cannot acquire authority.

## Verification result

Isolation, deterministic comparison, fallback, and redaction checks prove authoritative results remain unchanged.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one non-authoritative shadow-execution path; comparison cases are proof inputs.

## Dependencies

- PROV-A: #514

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Shadow and authority paths are distinguishable
- [ ] Inputs and comparison rules are exact
- [ ] Failures preserve the authoritative result
- [ ] Evidence is redacted

## Owned paths

- `adl/src/provider/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/provider/prov-b/**`

## PVF lanes

- `shadow-isolation`
- `deterministic-comparison`
- `fallback`
- `redaction`

## Stop conditions

- Shadow output can mutate authority
- Comparison inputs drift

## Non-goals

- Provider benchmark marketing claims
- Production cutover
